summary_1line: After the war, grieving Dhritarashtra tries to crush Bhima but is tricked; Gandhari confronts the Pandavas as women lament the devastation of Kurukshetra.

image_candidates.scene_text: Blind Dhritarashtra embraces and crushes an iron statue of Bhima, shattering it while Krishna secretly pulls the real Bhima away.
Gandhari lifts the edge of her blindfold and her gaze burns Yudhishthira’s toenail as he bows trembling before her.
On the blood-soaked field of Kurukshetra, widows with disheveled hair wander among corpses while vultures and jackals feed on fallen warriors.
